name: all_unknown_no_escalation
description: Two sources both abstain (Unknown) on the same claim. The distribution is all mass on U (dist[U]=1.0, every other variant 0.0), so the informative mass T+P+D+F+C is zero. Under v1.2 escalation requires informative > 0, so an all-Unknown distribution never escalates — nothing conflicts, so there is nothing to escalate. This is the companion to fixture 11: it pins the boundary where the informative denominator is empty. (Under v1.1 this was also false, since dist[C]=0 < 0.3; the two rules agree here, and must.)
